_comment: Stack members wired to the arenyze API. Add an entry per player; the daily GitHub Action (player-stats.yml) fetches each and writes players.json. platform: uplay | psn | xbl | steam.
_roster_note: The app's Players tab lists whoever is on the ROSTER tab; this file only supplies the numbers. Keep each label matching the roster name (or the key matching its slug) so the two stay joined — a roster member with no entry here still gets a card, just an unlinked one.
_handle_note: Leave handle empty ("") to reserve a slot without linking — it shows a 'not linked yet' card and costs no API calls. Fill in the exact Ubisoft name (with any trailing dot) to activate it.
_api_key_note: R6DATA_API_KEY now holds an arenyze (r6.arenyze.com) v2 key. Arenyze keys have no documented fixed expiry, so api_key_expires is null; set a date only if your key has one and you want the early warning. Live quota/plan is reported per run from /r6/api/me/usage.
